parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The network uses different topologies in different areas of the sites. In one building there are
five computers connected in a mesh topology.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Describe what is meant by a mesh topology.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Give two advantages of using a mesh topology instead of a bus topology.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
The computers in one room are set up as thin-clients in a client-server model.
Describe the role of the different computers in this model.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
Students can connect their devices to the university network using cables or a wireless
connection.
Explain the benefits to the students of allowing them to use both wired and wireless
connections.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text:
One site has split the network into several subnetworks.
An IP address in a subnetwork is divided into two parts.
Identify and describe the two parts of an IP address in a subnetwork.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
The car rental database is not normalised. The current database design is:
BOOKING(CarRegistration, StartDate, EndDate,
CarModel, CarColour, CustomerFirstName)
CUSTOMER(CustomerFirstName, CustomerLastName, EmailAddress,
TelephoneNumber)
Write a normalised database design for this database.
All tables must be in Third Normal Form (3NF).
Use the field names given and underline the primary key fields.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: The data is validated and verified when it is entered into the database.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
The car registration number must be: 1 letter, followed by 3 numbers, followed by 2
letters.
For example, A123AA is valid but A12AA is invalid.
One way that a registration number can be validated is by using a presence check to
make sure the registration number has been entered.
Describe two other ways that the car registration number can be validated.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
Describe two ways that the car registration number can be verified when it is entered
into the database.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text:
State why the car registration number might be incorrect even after it has been validated
and verified.
